concepts.name: 1 太空研究站
concepts.palette: Ultramarine blue #324BC4, cool cyan #69CFDB, bright but restrained tangerine #F28B45, porcelain white #F0F4F3 and midnight blue structural accents.
concepts.detail: Art direction: retro-futurist orbital science miniatures, clean hard-surface 3D with gently rounded edges, matte white enamel, blue anodized metal, cyan translucent glass, restrained orange controls, consistent isometric view, sophisticated friendly science-game aesthetic without neon/glow. LEFT / learning: a compact freestanding foldable star-chart console, two angled dark blue screens showing a simple three-node navigation route in cyan, a short orange stylus and three tactile stepping keys; no readable UI. CENTER / research: a compact orbital measurement instrument on a white pedestal, nested blue/cyan rings holding three orange sample spheres with a tiny optical sensor arm, strongly scientific not mystical. RIGHT / lab: a small modular orbital research station made from three connected white-and-blue dome capsules on a shared compact base, cyan windows and orange connector hubs, showing connected working spaces; no people or classical doorway. All three share the same engineered design language.
concepts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE coherent concept sheet of three illustrated navigation icons for a researcher's academic website, balancing playfulness and academic credibility.
Layout: wide 3:1 horizontal canvas, exactly THREE evenly spaced isolated icon groups in one row, left to right representing COURSES / RESEARCH / LAB COMMUNITY. Each group contained fully in its own third, with equal visual weight, generous separation, small transparent margins and all silhouettes entirely inside the canvas. Icons must remain readable around 96px each, so prioritize strong shape design over microdetails. No labels or written text anywhere, no letters, digits, logos or watermark.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha throughout the empty space and gaps, including around and between objects. Crisp clean silhouette edges, no white fringe, colored halo, glow, haze, checkerboard or full canvas backdrop. Only subtle local shadows belonging to objects. No website mockup, panels, frame around the whole sheet, or unrelated decoration. Each icon is a purposeful semantic illustration rather than a scene.
This is a brand NEW design direction, not a recolor of a book/magnifier/university arch set. Do not use an open book, a research paper with magnifier, or a classical university entrance.
Color palette: Ultramarine blue #324BC4, cool cyan #69CFDB, bright but restrained tangerine #F28B45, porcelain white #F0F4F3 and midnight blue structural accents.

RIGHT / lab: a small modular orbital research station made from three connected white-and-blue dome capsules on a shared compact base, cyan windows and orange connector hubs, showing connected working spaces; no people or classical doorway. concepts.name: 2 自然野外手記
concepts.palette: Eucalyptus green #507B61, dusty terracotta #C77353, warm ochre #D8AC54, cream canvas #F3E9D0, deep pine ink #263F35.
concepts.detail: Art direction: warm naturalist expedition equipment rendered in confident hand-painted gouache with dry-brush details ONLY inside object boundaries, clear simple silhouettes, friendly scientific field-guide personality, slight three-quarter perspective. LEFT / learning: an unrolled cream route map with green contour bands and exactly three ochre waypoint dots, a small terracotta compass resting beside it; not a book. CENTER / research: a mineral sample tray with one faceted green crystal, one warm ochre rock, a simple terracotta caliper and a small blank specimen tag, expressing observation and comparison; no magnifier, no research document. RIGHT / lab community: a compact eucalyptus-green expedition tent with terracotta trim, two small differently colored field backpacks next to it and a tiny shared observation flag, suggesting a collaborative field station. No landscape, floor plane, trees or background.

concepts.name: 3 復古科學儀器
concepts.palette: Burnt vermilion #CA593C, deep petrol blue #285B68, pale mint #B8D1C6, warm ivory #F2E9D5 and a little dark graphite.
concepts.detail: Art direction: mid-century scientific equipment miniatures, stylized technical editorial illustration with solid enamel color blocks, fine precise dark contour lines, restrained screenprint grain inside the objects, mostly frontal three-quarter view. High character, mature academic laboratory atmosphere. LEFT / learning: a small petrol-blue desktop card-index cabinet with three vermilion/pale-mint drawer tabs and one open drawer showing a tidy succession of ivory index cards; no text and not a book. CENTER / research: a compact vermilion optical bench with a triangular pale-mint glass prism, two adjustable blue optical holders and a small ivory analog dial, suggesting testing an idea through measurement; no readable numbers, no magnifier. RIGHT / lab community: a compact shared petrol-blue laboratory workbench with two different stools, two task lamps facing one shared instrument and an ivory shelf, conveying a place to work together. No whole room, background wall, people or university arch.

concepts.name: 4 幾何解謎
concepts.palette: Vivid coral #F06C58, cobalt blue #3B55C9, pale lemon #F0D777, fresh mint #8BCDB7 and cream #FBF5E9. Keep colors balanced, no neon emission.
concepts.detail: Art direction: bold contemporary geometric puzzle-game objects, smooth matte blocks with crisp hard edges and minimal 3D shading, playful intelligent abstraction, consistent isometric view. Strong memorable silhouettes and no textures, no outlines. LEFT / learning: three ascending cobalt/coral/lemon stepping blocks with one small mint sphere progressing toward the upper platform, a clear path of learning. CENTER / research: an exploded geometric polyhedron puzzle, six simple colored pieces aligned around a small cobalt central node, suggesting analysis, structure and discovering how parts fit; no magnifier, paper, book or rings. RIGHT / lab community: three differently colored interlocking arch-shaped blocks forming one stable small pavilion around a shared cream center, expressing complementary collaborators building one structure; abstract collaborative sculpture, not a classical architectural doorway. Do not put everything on one shared board; keep the three groups distinct.

concepts.name: 5 學院探索徽章
concepts.palette: Deep burgundy #7D3348, antique gold #C8A35B, forest teal #2E665E, parchment ivory #F3E5C9 and small dusty rose accents.
concepts.detail: Art direction: collectible academic expedition PATCHES with real tactile embroidered thread, woven ivory textile interiors, tidy burgundy/teal/gold stitching, elegant simplified emblem shapes. Front-facing, softly shaded raised thread, mature collegiate field-club feeling with a little RPG badge charm. Exactly three standalone cloth patches, each a different silhouette, not shields for combat. LEFT / learning: a rounded triangular burgundy-edged patch depicting a simple gold torch above three teal ascending steps. CENTER / research: a hexagonal teal-edged patch depicting an ivory triangular prism with three gold/rose/teal rays emerging toward three small stitched nodes, symbolizing inquiry and decomposition. RIGHT / lab community: a round burgundy-edged patch depicting three interlocking gold/teal/rose loops gathered around a small ivory central star, symbolizing collaboration. No books, papers, magnifiers or university buildings. All symbol details simplified enough to read at small size. Cloth is only INSIDE the three patch silhouettes; the rest of the image is transparent. No text, initials, numbers, official insignia or existing brands.
